subject: SOC2 / SIG: Harmonizing network evidence for Dedicated & Private deployments
body:
Message 1 (2027-03-23 09:12 PDT)
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acme-corp.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: SOC2 Audit <audit@veridian-audit.com>
Subject: SOC2 request: network diagrams for Dedicated & Private

Hi Sean,

We're moving into the final phase of our SOC 2 intake and Veridian asked for a tightened set of network artifacts that align SIG/CAIQ items with what you provide for both Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem). Can you send:

- A single-page explainer diagram for Dedicated showing the tenant isolation controls and fallback routing
- A single-page explainer for Private (VPC + optional on-prem) showing control plane separation and KMS boundaries
- A short matrix (1 page) mapping SIG/CAIQ control references to the artifacts you will supply

We'd like these by EOD Tuesday (2027-03-30) to stay on schedule. Also please flag anything that will need a redaction or NDA before sharing with the external audit team.

Thanks,
Megan
Senior Cloud Security Manager
Acme Cloud

---
Message 2 (2027-03-23 10:03 PDT)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: network diagrams for Dedicated & Private

Hi Megan — thanks for the clear ask. Quick plan to deliver the right pack without overexposing internal topology: 

1) Deliverables (by 2027-03-30 EOD):
   - network-diagram-dedicated-v1.png (single-page explainer, high-level zones only)
   - network-diagram-private-v1.png (single-page VPC/on-prem explainer, annotated control plane boundaries)
   - isolation-matrix-v3.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ mapping + evidence pointers)
   - short cover note (PDF) that calls out redaction guidance and access restrictions

2) Redaction / NDA notes:
   - We will redact internal CIDR ranges and instance IDs.
   - Any low-level runbook or packet captures will require a Mutual NDA + controlled sharing channel.

3) Who's on point: Kimberly will produce diagrams (she owns the topology pack). Marissa will do the SIG/CAIQ mapping and cover note. I will coordinate packaging and the HubSpot attachment.

Is there anyone else on your audit team who needs a separate non-redacted view (we can do a live walkthrough under NDA)?

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Security Solutions (sales)
Redwood Inference

---
Message 3 (2027-03-24 11:29 PDT)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acme-corp.com>
Subject: Re: SOC2 request: network diagrams for Dedicated & Private

Folks — attaching two working canvases (see attachments stub).

Highlights / design decisions (short):
- Dedicated diagram will show: ingress edge -> load balancer -> tenant fronting pool -> model-serving pools -> isolated KMS gateway. No instance-level detail.
- Private diagram (VPC) will show: customer VPC peering/Transit Gateway model (optional on-prem site), private control plane with separate management plane subnets, and explicit egress filter box.
- Both artifacts will include a one-line "assurance statement" referencing automatic KV cache encryption in transit and at rest where appropriate.

Open items (need Sean / Marissa input):
- Does Acme need a labeled ASN/Peering point? If yes, we can show a generic peering cloud rather than an ASN.
- For KMS boundary: do we include the external KMS vendor name or reference as "customer-managed KMS"?

Attachments (working):
- network-diagram-dedicated-draft.png [attachment: network-diagram-dedicated-draft.png (image/png)]
- network-diagram-private-draft.png [attachment: network-diagram-private-draft.png (image/png)]

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Architect
Redwood Inference

---
Message 4 (2027-03-26 15:42 PDT)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acme-corp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Subject: Final evidence package and next steps

Hi Megan — bundled the requested deliverables and uploaded to the shared drive link below. Key things in the package: 

- network-diagram-dedicated-v1.png (single-page explainer; redacted CIDRs)
- network-diagram-private-v1.png (VPC + on-prem explainer; annotated control plane)
- isolation-matrix-v3.xlsx (SIG/CAIQ mapping; column A = control id, B = evidence artifact, C = location/link, D = remarks)
- soc2-sig-caiaq-questionnaire.pdf (filled answers for the items referenced in the mapping)
- cover-note.pdf (short guidance on redaction and a request for an NDA if a deeper artifact is needed)

Notes on provenance and what to expect in audit:
- The diagrams are intentionally high-level; the isolation matrix points auditors to runbooks and logs (audit-ready) but those lower-level artifacts will be shared only under NDA.
- For Private deployments: the KMS boundary is marked as "customer-managed KMS" unless the customer has requested we name their KMS provider.

Next steps:
1) If Veridian wants a live walk-through of any control, we can do a timeboxed session (30–45 minutes) under the NDA.
2) If the auditor requests unredacted traces, we will need a signed data access addendum — I can draft that.
3) Please confirm acceptance or list follow-up items by Friday EOD; we'll treat that as the acceptance gating the SOC 2 intake timeline.

Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3CNetEvidence
HubSpot: HUBSPOT-ACME-3372

Thanks — attaching the final filenames here for your tracker.

Attachments (delivered): network-diagram-dedicated-v1.png; network-diagram-private-v1.png; isolation-matrix-v3.xlsx; soc2-sig-caiaq-questionnaire.pdf; cover-note.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Technical Program Manager, Security Delivery
Redwood Inference

---
Message 5 (2027-03-26 16:01 PDT)
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Final evidence package and next steps

Marissa / team — received and reviewed quickly. The set looks good and the mapping is exactly what Veridian needs. Two small asks: 
- Can you add a one-line reference in the cover note to how you handle KV cache deletion for Dedicated instances (retention timeframe + deletion trigger)?
- For Private: please add a footnote that on-prem connections use customer-terminated VPNs and that Redwood does not hold customer on-prem keys.

If you can add those two clarifications by EOD tomorrow, we should be able to close the intake. We do not need any unredacted artifacts at this time.

Thanks,
Megan

[End of thread]
